assessmentQuestionVersion.name: SWS_RiskAssessment_Q5
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Current permanent boil advisory: System is currently under a permanent (long-term/indefinite) Boil Water Notice due to ongoing bacteriological risk. Current periodic boil advisory: System is currently subject to a periodic or intermittent Boil Water Notice, issued repeatedly or on an as-needed basis in response to recurring bacteriological monitoring results or operational conditions. Past boil advisories or periodic unsatisfactory results: System has a history of one or more previous Boil Water Notices (now rescinded) or periodic unsatisfactory bacteriological results, but is not currently under an active advisory. Meets guidelines: System has no history of Boil Water Notices and bacteriological monitoring consistently meets guidelines within the past five years or since infrastructure updates.
